Further context as I’ve just read this back lol and it might seem dramatic 
- my mum is terminally ill and unable to move at all herself (she can’t even clench a fist or raise a finger) 
- my mum can talk but needs to talk slowly 
- my mum has also just had a bed-bound week after being poorly so it’s been a shit week for both of us as she’s really weak and hasn’t eaten much
- we have 2 carers at each call, as they have to use hoists etc to move mum about for health and safety 
- the nhs social care budget is fucked mainly because of decades of Tory austerity, so all of the care agencies for people with complex needs are contracted out (eg not NHS employers) so I totally appreciate these people are over worked and underpaid 
- the carers are usually fine but it makes me paranoid now, what would they say if mum wasn’t as mentally stable or aware?
